title: Goja runtime integration test
description: Proves the embedded Goja JavaScript runtime is usable and safe via four integration scenarios: hello world execution, ontology.search with a where clause against a real Bleve index, sandbox escape prevention (fetch/require blocked), and infinite-loop timeout enforcement (5s default).

scenarios.name: findOrdersOver
scenarios.source: function main(input) { var r = ontology.search("order", {type:"gt",field:"amount",value:1000}); var ids=[]; for(var i=0;i<r.data.length;i++){ids.push(r.data[i].orderId);} return ids; }

expected.error: fetch is not defined or not a function
require is not defined or not a function

notes: Function source is stored in PostgreSQL (functions table, migration 000021) and retrieved by name before execution.
The ossOntologyClient adapter bridges oss.Service to the functions.OntologyClient interface by pre-binding ontologyRID.
Dangerous globals are double-deleted: set to Undefined then Delete from globalObject.
Memory watchdog polls every 50ms; timeout uses context cancellation + vm.Interrupt.
